quality_findings.finding: 15 rows were never sent because one sentence exceeds 5,500 characters; 11 flagged master rows remain uncovered.

Gap-fill run 2 reading of 58 outputs stratified by tradition, work and length: 7 had a meaning-level error (12 percent); four of the seven read a common noun as a proper name (the imperative 'aslim' as the name Aslam, 'al-fatima' (the weaner) as Fatima, 'a'bud' (slaves) as ʿAbud, 'al-ʿaraq' (sweat) as the place Arq), others were 'adhdhana' (call to prayer) read as 'gave permission', 'khalatuhu' (maternal aunt) as paternal aunt, and 'al-khitan' read as two males. Short chainless texts and sources with ambiguous common nouns are the weak spot, as in the first pilot.

The terminology prompt (60-row paired pilot, 58 compared) put the honorific in one parenthetical form 137 times against 56, used the glossary's ʿ scheme 64 times against 0, and 'God' 1 time against 4, with no worse meaning in a 36-pair reading; it also produced 'O the Messenger of Allah' in 7 draft-1 outputs (fixed by vocative entries) and occasional macron transliteration (guarded; the row is retried with the base prompt), and renders a bare honorific with no subject ('And (peace and blessings be upon him) said') where the Arabic omits the Prophet's name.
At temperature 0.7 the same prompt gave different meanings on the same source in two runs (a dropped 'not' on pc_73910), so a single sample is partly noise.

Run 2 stopped at 7,046 of 31,090 selected reports because the OpenRouter account balance reached zero (HTTP 402 'Insufficient credits', limit_source openrouter_credits); the key's own limit had 47.97 USD remaining. About 24,000 reports remain; the estimated remaining cost is about 1.3 USD.

2026-11-22 reading of 40 random published drafts (10 each from Sunni, Imami, Zaydi, Ibadi; one reader against the Arabic): 5 had a meaning-level error: Sunni 3 (pc_47927 'give the beggar' rendered 'They rejected the liquid'; pc_631 'harvest your palm' rendered 'Come out, my grandfather ... you will believe'; pc_15571 speaker confusion), Zaydi 2 (jubar rendered 'tyrant'; 'ta'rif' rendered 'knows'), Imami 1 partial (garbled gloss), Ibadi 0. No dropped isnad and no invented text was seen. One reader's reading, not a reviewed measurement.

The screen held 194 of 25,094 events of 2026-11-22 (0.8 percent): diacritic transliteration 53 first, repetition loop 23, length ratio 21, truncation 1, Arabic leakage 1; after one retry 91 reports remain held out and are never shown.

allowed_uses: Chain-fix submissions under the agreement and hold rules (reviews/ai/tools/chain-fix-*.ts)
Applied readings labelled 'Read by model, awaiting final review' (and 'No chain is written in this report' for an agreed empty reading)
Proposals beyond the chain for a person to decide
prohibited_uses: Writing a chain without two agreeing independent readings and no hold
Feeding teacher and student lists before the work's agreed-reading error rate is measured (chain_fix_work_settings)

quality_findings.finding: Pilot v2 re-scored under the v3 tool: 213 of 279 applied, 210 right (99 percent, 96 to 100), measured on the readings the holds were tuned on (in-sample); batch 001 is the out-of-sample measurement.

Batch 001 judged by one independent model reader (not blind, not a scholar): agreed, unheld readings right in 98.6% (96.8 to 99.4, weighted) against 16.0% for the stored chains; no reading broke a correct stored chain (0 of 244). Under the v3.1 tool and the owner's rulings of 2026-11-22: 237 of 241 right, 0 wrong, 4 undecided; the 36 no-chain readings all right.
